added.title: VP - Product, Digital Transfer Agency, Digital Assets
added.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented VP, Product Management – Digital Assets – Digital Transfer Agent & Tokenization
to lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery of our digital assets product portfolio. This leader will identify market opportunities, define product strategy, and drive the development of innovative, scalable, and compliant digital asset solutions that meet client needs and support business growth, across Digital Transfer Agency and Tokenization.

This role sits at the intersection of product, technology, operations, risk, legal, compliance, and commercial teams. The ideal candidate brings deep product management expertise, strong market insight, and a solid understanding of the evolving digital assets ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Define and lead the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for digital assets products and capabilities
Identify customer needs, market opportunities, competitive trends, and regulatory developments to inform product direction
Evaluate, prioritize, and launch new products, features, and enhancements aligned with business goals and client demand
Build business cases, including market sizing, ROI analysis, pricing, and commercialization strategy
Partner closely with engineering, operations, legal, compliance, risk, and other cross-functional teams to deliver products from concept through launch and ongoing optimization
Develop go-to-market plans in collaboration with sales, marketing, and client-facing teams
Ensure products are operationally ready, scalable, and aligned with regulatory and risk requirements
Monitor product performance, adoption, and market feedback to continuously improve the product portfolio
Act as a senior thought partner and subject matter expert on digital assets across the organization
Lead complex, high-impact initiatives and influence stakeholders across all levels of the business

What We’re Looking For

Significant experience in product management, with a track record of leading complex products or platforms from strategy through execution
Strong knowledge of digital assets and related market infrastructure, which may include blockchain-based products, tokenized assets, custody, trading, wallets, settlement, staking, or adjacent capabilities
Experience operating in a regulated environment and partnering with legal, compliance, risk, and operations teams
Strong commercial acumen, including experience with product strategy, business case development, pricing, and go-to-market planning
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills
Ability to thrive in a fast-evolving market and navigate ambiguity with a strategic, client-focused mindset

What Sets You Apart

Deep understanding of trends shaping the digital assets landscape and their implications for institutional or enterprise clients
Experience developing product with a SEC regulated Transfer Agency business, or like
Ability to balance innovation with strong operational, regulatory, and risk discipline
Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
Experience building and scaling new product offerings in emerging or rapidly changing markets

Why Join Us

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of digital assets products within a dynamic and highly visible leadership role. You’ll work with cross-functional teams to bring new capabilities to market, solve complex industry challenges, and help define how digital asset solutions evolve in a changing financial and regulatory landscape.

Salary range $240,000.00- $260,000.00. Bonus Eligible.

Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.

Please visit www.broadridgebenefits.com for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings .

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

Use of AI in Hiring

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

We recognize that ensuring our long-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. added.title: Senior Vice President, Product Design
added.description:
Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Design
to join our Enterprise Transformation
team. This role is located in New York, NY or Pittsburgh, PA or Lake Mary, FL
.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the design strategy and vision for a broad product area or complex feature set, connecting user needs, business priorities, technical constraints, and platform opportunities.
Lead end-to-end design work across discovery, concept development, prototyping, validation, and delivery.
Serve as the primary design leader within the team, independently setting direction, creating structure, and establishing a high standard for design quality and execution.
Elevate design craft through strong visual, interaction, and product design judgment, bringing rigor, polish, consistency, and clarity to the user experience.
Demonstrate a builder mindset by creating scalable patterns, reusable approaches, and practical ways of working that improve product quality, speed, and consistency.
Demonstrate an owner mindset by proactively identifying opportunities and risks, aligning stakeholders, driving decisions, and ensuring follow-through from concept to shipped outcome.
Lead cross-functional workshops, design reviews, and working sessions to build alignment and move teams from ambiguity to clarity.
Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and key stakeholders to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and deliver cohesive experiences.
Define design scope, milestones, priorities, and success measures for initiatives within their area, and contribute to effective planning and execution within agile delivery environments.
Create high-quality design artifacts and prototypes that support alignment, decision-making, validation, and implementation.
Work in modern product development workflows with engineering and product partners, including familiarity with Git-based collaboration, repositories, versioned artifacts, and spec-driven development practices.
Contribute to modern handoff approaches by helping teams move from static documentation toward clearer, shared specifications, living artifacts, and tighter design-engineering collaboration throughout delivery.
Influence cross-functional leadership to prioritize product excellence and invest in improvements that raise experience quality over time.
Use qualitative and quantitative inputs, including research, analytics, experimentation, and stakeholder insight, to inform decisions and continuously improve solutions after launch.

AI Design Fluency

Demonstrate fluency in designing AI-assisted and AI-enabled experiences, including workflows that incorporate generation, automation, recommendations, and conversational interactions where appropriate.
Understand how to design for trust, transparency, usability, and human oversight in AI-enabled experiences, including fallback states, review patterns, and clear user control.
Apply strong judgment to when AI should enhance a workflow and when more traditional interaction patterns are the better solution.
Use AI-enabled tools to accelerate design exploration, synthesis, prototyping, iteration, and workflow efficiency while maintaining high standards of craft and product judgment.
Partner with product and engineering to shape practical, user-centered AI opportunities that deliver meaningful value.
Incorporate responsible design considerations such as accessibility, clarity, privacy, and bias awareness into AI-enabled product experiences.

Tools and Ways of Working

Comfortable working in agile product delivery environments and using modern digital product workflows to support planning, collaboration, and execution.
Experience using contemporary AI-enabled tools such as Devin, Claude, Codex, and similar technologies to accelerate thinking, making, prototyping, and delivery.
Familiarity with Git-based workflows, repositories, and modern collaboration practices that support transparent iteration, versioning, and closer partnership with engineering.
Understanding of spec-driven development and modern handoff practices that improve clarity, reduce translation gaps, and enable more efficient implementation.
Strong capability in storytelling, documentation, and workshop facilitation to support alignment and execution.
Familiarity with research, analytics, and experimentation practices that help teams understand user behavior, validate decisions, and measure impact.

Leadership and Collaboration

Builds strong relationships across cross-functional teams and understands how their work connects to broader organizational goals.
Communicates clearly and confidently, navigating complex situations and differing perspectives with sound judgment and professionalism.
Advocates for a strong point of view while remaining collaborative and able to respectfully disagree and commit to aligned decisions.
Contributes to a culture of accountability, collaboration, curiosity, honesty, and relentless pursuit of better solutions.
Operates with a high degree of independence, requiring limited day-to-day direction while exercising strong judgment on new and complex assignments.
Helps raise awareness of the value of design by modeling strong craft, clear thinking, and a high standard of execution within a team that is continuing to mature its design practice.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

Bachelor’s degree in psychology, user experience, design, human computer interaction or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required; advanced degree preferred
10-12 years of related experience required
Demonstrated experience leading design for complex products, platforms, or workflows with meaningful impact on team and business outcomes.
Strong experience partnering with product and engineering to deliver high-quality digital experiences.
Proven ability to operate as a highly independent design leader in environments with limited design support or infrastructure.
Experience working in modern product development environments that use Git, repositories, and evolving design-to-engineering workflows is strongly preferred.
Experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus.
Demonstrated AI design fluency and experience designing or contributing to AI-enabled product experiences is strongly preferred.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

added.title: Product Design Director, Business Travel
added.description:
We’re currently seeking a Product Design Director to lead our Business Travel team, part of the Experience Design organization.

The Premium Design team sets the bar for Capital One’s high-spender customer experience ecosystem, revolving around highly useful, personalized, and high-stakes products. We are currently seeking a design leader to join our team and lead the Business Travel experiences. This role will drive differentiated vision and lead teams to craft exceptional end-to-end native experiences that allow Capital One to win at the top of the market. You will also work closely with craft leads, designers and cross functional teams to push creative boundaries while ensuring business impact and customer value.

The Experience Design team at Capital One is at the forefront of enriching our customers’ digital and physical experiences and we are passionate about creating memorable, meaningful product experiences that build the Capital One brand with humanity and drive business advantage and innovation. We champion a thriving environment of collaboration, authenticity and healthy critique, in which we honor diversity of thought, create a culture of belonging, and elevate one another. If you’re a creative innovator who embraces an environment where you can experiment, learn, and change banking for good, we’d love to hear from you .

Role Expectations

As a Director of Business Travel, you’ll lead a talented, cross-disciplinary team of designers and collaborate deeply with our research teams and Product and Tech leadership. You’ll be responsible for leading high-impact, highly complex projects and defining and driving design strategy that informs the higher-level vision of the organization and aligns to business objectives.

Here are some of the expected competencies for this role:

Product Design Expertise:
Leverage established expertise and leadership in product design to elevate the quality and maturity of the design practice at Capital One. Leveraging a variety of skills across interaction, visual and service design; in collaboration with cross-functional partners, help to oversee and optimize the use of appropriate tools, platforms, frameworks and design systems and enable your team to develop artifacts that may include vision stories, journey maps, blueprints, high-fidelity designs and prototypes

Leadership:
Create conditions for a positive and inclusive team environment and set a vision for an inclusive, collaborative culture that makes your team feel valued and heard

Human-Centered:
Champion voices of both customers and partners, modeling the mindset that business and customer outcomes are not distinct but complementary, ultimately resulting in experiences that exceed baseline customer needs and expectations

Business-Focused:
Demonstrate expert knowledge of products, processes, our customers, competitors and industry market trends, applying relevant insights to shape how Design should engage and solve business challenges

Problem-Solving:
Share insights around technical advances and data capabilities that could influence outcomes, while helping larger teams navigate technical limitations and boundaries in service of bold technological solutions, data destinations and efficiency

Collaboration:
Connect the dots across teams, portfolios, platforms and LOBs, bringing together partners and processes in ways that drive more coherent experiences, accelerate delivery and elevate the value of design

Communication:
Present work across levels and job functions, modeling a strategic human-centered approach that integrates design frameworks, data and research insights to make the complex accessible, influence senior stakeholders and achieve impactful results

The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio demonstrating your leadership, process, results and impact.

Basic Qualifications:

At least 8 years of experience in a product design role
At least 3 years of experience leading design teams

Preferred Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in product design role
5+ years of experience leading design teams
Experience in a design toolkit that spans product design, service design, design strategy and content design
Experience leading product design teams operating across UX and UI, strategy, content and research from strategy through delivery to market
Experience partnering with product managers, engineers, marketing and analytics leaders across multiple business lines to shape strategy, OKRs, roadmaps and operating models
Experience working within a design system
Proficiency with web and mobile technologies and platforms, navigating technology considerations and constraints to drive sound product and experience decisions
Expertise with design and prototyping tools such as Figma
Experience managing an interdisciplinary design team
Proficiency in business case development, grounding product and user experience decisions to business value
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Exceptional interpersonal skills and relationship building across complex organizations
Exceptional people management and development skills

XBOX Media Solutions is seeking a Senior Director Gaming - Measurement and Insights to lead our gaming-dedicated measurement and insights function. This leader will lead an organization that includes measurement, insights, and data science to demonstrate the Return on investment (ROI) of gaming to our advertising customers, generate novel insights which highlight the unique power of gaming to advertising, work with game studios and platforms to empirically understand the needs of players as it relates to advertising, and work with internal measurement and product stakeholders to shape the future of advertising measurement for our gaming business.

Deliver revenue via ROI measurement and exceptional, industry-leading insights designed to shape the future of the gaming advertising industry.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Starting August 17, 2026, Microsoft Advertising employees who live within a 50-mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week. Define and execute a unified measurement and insights strategy across sales, marketing, and product stakeholders.
Engage with clients at a senior level across a variety of measurement topics ranging from Media Mix Marketing (MMM) to Multi-touch Attibution (MTA), to shape and defend gaming investments.
Champion customer measurement needs with gaming studios and platforms, in addition to advertising product teams by translating measurement outcomes into product recommendations.
Manage and develop a growing team of researchers and analytics professionals.

Act as an industry thought leader on the basis of measurement, particularly as it pertains to gaming audiences.

OR Doctoral Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Social Sciences, Statistics, or related field AND 5+ years experience in data science, research, marketing or business-related roles.

OR Master's Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Social Sciences, Statistics, or related field AND 12+ years experience in data science, research, marketing or business-related roles
OR Doctorate in Business, Marketing, Economics, Social Sciences, Statistics, or related field AND 8+ years experience in data science, research, marketing or business-related roles.

10+ years’ experience leading measurement, research, and/or insights teams in digital advertising
Track record of full funnel measurement knowledge, from brand to performance outcomes, in addition to emerging frontiers of measurement (attention, AI, etc.).
Measurement ecosystem experience – deep knowledge of industry measurement trends, third party tools, and common methodologies (experimentation, causal inference, econometric modeling, etc.).
Proficient primary and secondary research skills, ranging from survey design to rigorous implementation of 3rd party data.
History of building high-performing teams and working across highly matrixed organizations.
Experience as a collaborator who seeks solutions for broader organizational benefit while driving toward own goals.
Experience partnering across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to align strategies and deliver measurable results.
Experience in gaming and/or CTV ecosystems.

added.title: Director of ML Engineering - Conversation Product Area
added.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.

You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.

What You'll Do

Own engineering execution and technical direction for the Conversation Product Area, including the Agent Engine, the evaluation infrastructure, the Search platform, the AI Voice platform (Speak), and some consumer agentic features built on top of the Agent Engine. This spans production systems at massive scale, applied ML research, and infrastructure that other product areas depend on.
Co-lead the Product Area in a paired product/engineering model. You own engineering and deeply partner with a product counterpart that owns product strategy. You’ll operate as a single leadership unit for planning, prioritization, and external representation. This partnership is core to the success of the role.
You’ll manage a team of ~70 engineers, with a small team of Senior Engineering Managers and Staff/Principal engineers directly reporting to you. You’ll develop and hold accountable the EM layer running the PA's roughly 9 teams. Your leverage comes through your SEMs and Staff engineers, but you’re ultimately accountable for delivery across the entire product area.
Drive the migration of the company’s existing agentic infrastructure onto the shared Agent Engine, in close partnership product teams across the company, balancing migration speed against product teams’ existing roadmap work.
Own the technical strategy for Spotify's first-party voice investment: what Speak builds versus buys, how the team organizes and delivers against a market that's commoditizing fast, and how the character/brand voice decisions for agent experiences get made and shipped on their own aggressive timelines.
Define and hold the technical bar on evaluation. Build the discipline around building feature-specific judges and datasets and product decisions based on those eval sets.
Set and enforce engineering quality standards appropriate to an AI-assisted development era including code review discipline and test coverage especially designed for teams that are increasingly writing code with AI assistance.
Participate as a full member of the broader leadership group, co-developing with your peers and executives the operating model for the whole studio across capacity management, project prioritization, studio communication principles, and building a healthy engineering culture in a highly changeable environment.
Represent the Conversation PA's engineering point of view in high visibility, company-wide architecture and steerco conversations with senior leaders.

Who You Are

You are deeply technical, not tech-adjacent. This PA's defining work (a new shared agent runtime and harness, a scaled evaluation system, a voice/speech stack) requires a Director who can evaluate architecture proposals, hold their own in a room with senior ICs, contribute technically in meaningful ways, and make tough tiebreaking and tradeoff calls.
You have run large engineering orgs through platform consolidations, migrations, or evolutions, and you’ve had to earn trust by building highly scaled and functional platform technology.
You have experience with at least two of: LLM-based agent systems and orchestration, evaluation/eval-infrastructure design (including automated judges and regression suites), large-scale retrieval or search systems, or speech/voice ML systems and production voice infrastructure.
You've managed managers, not just individual contributors. You know how to build a management structure that scales.
You have a track record of building strong but nimble teams, with experience restructuring, shifting team resourcing, adjusting to fast changing priorities or shifting needs without losing delivery momentum.

Where You'll Be

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas or EMEA region as long as we have a work location.
This team operates primarily within the Eastern North America and Central European time zones for collaboration, so we ask that you be located within a time zone that enables regular overlap with the team.

The United States base range for this position is $281,196 – $401,709 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know – we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Spotify transformed music listening forever when we launched in 2008. Our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Everything we do is driven by our love for music and podcasting. Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

added.title: Vice President of Product Strategy
added.description:
Company Description
Witt Lake Asset Management is an investment management firm focused on delivering disciplined, research-driven strategies to help clients achieve long-term financial goals. The firm emphasizes rigorous analysis, risk-aware portfolio construction, and transparent communication with its clients. Team members collaborate across investment, product, and operations functions to design solutions that meet the needs of institutional and individual investors. The culture values integrity, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement in both investment practices and client service.
Role Description
The Vice President of Product Strategy is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the design, positioning, and evolution of Witt Lake Asset Management’s investment product offerings. This role involves defining product vision and strategy, assessing market opportunities, and ensuring that products align with client needs and the firm’s growth objectives. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting market and competitive analysis, collaborating with investment and sales teams to refine product features, and developing go-to-market and pricing strategies. The Vice President will prepare product narratives and materials, monitor product performance against strategic and financial goals, and make recommendations for enhancements, launches, or rationalizations. This role also includes driving cross-functional initiatives, setting product roadmaps, and presenting strategic recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Qualifications

added.description:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring And How We Work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

About The Job

Twilio is looking for a Senior Principal, Product Management to deliver our strategic vision for the Developer Platform
. You will manage foundational services, APIs, and infrastructure, driving the roadmap that empowers internal teams and partners to scale confidently.

You will treat the platform as a product
, shifting platform engineering from reactive, ad-hoc support into proactive, self-service experiences. Grounded in industry research (DORA, CNCF, Team Topologies, etc..), you will introduce golden paths, a discoverable developer portal, self-service tools, and high-quality documentation to reduce cognitive load and support burdens across Twilio.

Collaborating with product leaders, engineering, architecture, and design, you will define the future of developer experience, tooling, deployment, and operational capabilities, acting as the steward for evangelizing our developer platform capabilities and narrative and driving roadmap prioritization across a scalable cloud platform.

Key Skills

Platform-as-a-Product Expertise: Proficiency in applying product management methodologies—including user research, roadmapping, and KPI definition—to internal infrastructure.
Architectural & Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes, microservices, CI/CD) and observability frameworks, enabling credible engagement with engineering leads.
Developer Experience Design: Proven ability to identify developer friction points and architect solutions like developer portals, golden paths, and documentation-as-code to drive self-service.
Stakeholder Influence & Evangelism: Capacity to build compelling narratives that align cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Security) and drive internal platform adoption.
Performance Analytics: Experience defining and using success metrics (DORA, adoption, reliability) to advocate for data-driven product strategies.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

Own the Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the multi-quarter strategy for foundational services, ensuring the roadmap balances technical debt, scalability, and new feature velocity.
Transition to Self-Service: Actively shift the platform from reactive, 'ticket-based' support to a scalable, proactive product model by establishing paved roads and service catalogs.
Lead Cross-functional Integration: Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Security leads to ensure platform solutions are extensible, compliant, and meet the unique needs of internal developers.
Drive Developer Productivity: Champion continuous improvements in APIs, SDKs, and sandbox environments to reduce time-to-first-deploy and cognitive load.
Measure and Optimize: Establish governance frameworks and KPI dashboards to track adoption, support deflection, and reliability, iteratively refining the platform based on usage data and developer feedback.
Customer focus: Deeply understand customer needs and advocate for customer-centric product & engineering practices, using developer interviews and usage data to translate requests into root causes.
Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the voice of the Twilio platform across the organization (internal development platform, deployment systems, developer experience and tooling, etc.), ensuring stakeholder needs are well understood and incorporated into the product planning process.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:
12+ years of product management experience building large scale cloud services platforms; specifically building cloud native commerce systems for usage-based and metered products at a very large scale
Proven track record of results including establishing ambitious goals, achieving /over-achieving those goals and taking overall responsibility for customer and business outcomes
A track record of driving companies through ground-breaking change with the ability to see the big-picture while also being hands-on in the details
Executive presence with strong communication skills, and ability to communicate business value and product features/benefits and influence at the highest levels to drive change
Data-driven, outcomes oriented and a problem solver
Customer obsessed - passionate about the customer journey and the customer experience
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university, or equivalent experience

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in The Bay Area or Seattle area

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C.: $233,100.00–$259,000.00
Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $246,780.00–$274,200.00
Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $274,140.00–$304,600.00

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Do you want to have a direct impact on strategic deal-making and shape the future of cloud adoption? Are you excited to blend technical expertise with product strategy to solve complex business challenges?

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Manager - Technical to propose and own the development of new features and functionality within our broader platform. You will work closely with stakeholders to prioritize features and capabilities that scale our ability to execute transformative deals through automation and AI-driven solutions. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with deep technical expertise, a passion for learning new skills and experience in cloud-based or AI-driven product management.

Key job responsibilities

You will leverage both product management expertise and technical skills to understand complex business requirements, design innovative solutions, and develop generative AI-powered features that deliver measurable business impact.
You will propose and own the development of new features within our broader platform, working closely with stakeholders to prioritize features and capabilities that scale our ability to execute transformative deals through automation and AI-driven solutions.

You will translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling communications for senior leadership

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
5+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

added.description:
Description

AWS Professional Services is revolutionizing how we create value for customers. As Principal Consultant, Agentic Delivery Acceleration, you’ll pioneer the transformation of how we sell and deliver engagements by leveraging AI to accelerate adoption, reduce risk, and enhance experiences.

Within the Agentic Delivery Acceleration ProServe Team (ADAPT), you will lead strategic initiatives that define how ProServe operates at scale—standing up new programs, rapidly prototyping AI-powered solutions, and driving global adoption. You will play a critical role in translating complex cross-organizational challenges into scalable frameworks and agentic automation—enabling teams across Professional Services to work smarter and faster through the power of agentic AI.

If you’re passionate about leveraging AI to solve complex sales and delivery challenges and ready to drive meaningful innovation in one of the world’s most customer-obsessed organizations, this role offers an exceptional opportunity for transformative impact.

Key job responsibilities

Own and drive one or more strategic delivery initiatives from inception through scaled adoption globally
Define initiative vision, success metrics, and roadmaps using working backwards (PRFAQ/narrative) methodology
Rapidly prototype solutions using AIDLC (AI Development Lifecycle)—ship working prototypes in 45 day sprints
Transition prototype and beta solutions to General Availability (GA) via ProServe agents for long-term scale and maintenance
Build partnerships across AWS to align transformation with organizational priorities
Influence Director- and VP-level stakeholders without formal authority to secure resources and drive adoption
Measure initiative impact through portfolio-level business outcomes (adoption rates, cycle time reduction, margin improvement)
Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis and feedback loops
Influence strategic direction of global delivery capabilities and methodologies

About The Team

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

AWS Professional Services helps enterprise customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS. Our team provides expertise in cloud architecture, migration, application development, security, and operations to accelerate customers' cloud transformation journey. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about innovation, continuous improvement, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

added.title: Senior Manager, Product Management - Workforce Management Tools
added.description:
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About The Team

The Workforce & Intelligent Routing platform
controls how Capital One connects customers with the right support at the right time. We build the tech and data tools that power Card Servicing’s entire workforce—handling real-time work routing, demand forecasting, and scheduling. It’s practical, high-impact product work: making sure agents have fair, sensible schedules and customers get connected to someone who can genuinely solve their issue.

About The Role

As Sr. Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end Workforce Management product suite and lead the PM team behind it. You’ll oversee everything behind Card Servicing’s forecasting, capacity planning, schedule generation, and real-time operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll need to balance long-term strategy with a strong grasp of the underlying engineering, helping the team navigate complex technical, vendor, and operational tradeoffs.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Roadmap: Set a clear vision for the platform so the team builds toward long-term goals rather than just reacting to incoming requests.
Team Leadership: Coach and mentor a team of Product Managers, driving high standards and focusing on measurable outcomes rather than just output.
Delivery & Operations: Own the core scheduling and planning tools, directly influencing agent experience, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
Vendor Management: Translate Capital One’s technical and security needs for external vendors, while helping internal stakeholders plan around vendor roadmaps.
Technical Collaboration: Partner with Tech Leads to resolve architecture tradeoffs, clean up data pipelines, and ensure live deployments run smoothly.
Portfolio Prioritization: Balance immediate leadership demands with long-term platform health and technical dependencies.
Cross-Functional Influence: Work across Enterprise Data and Tech teams to ensure our workforce data is integrated and scalable across the company.
Executive Communication: Translate complex platform constraints into clear business terms for senior leaders, and convert business goals into actionable technical plans.

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
A Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing

OR

Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 4 years of Product Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products
